# Write-path matrix (generated)

**Status:** CURRENT, generated by `node tests/tools/write-paths.js --md` from the page source plus `docs/ops/write-paths.classification.json` (hand-checked fields). Branch work, not live. `tests/specs/write-path-inventory.spec.js` fails if a write path is added, removed or loses a guard without this classification being updated.

**98 write paths**: 88 in the owner dashboard, 10 on other pages (index.html is an identical copy of manual-order-entry.html).

Columns: **Stale** = conditional on the value the page showed (stale-tab / optimistic concurrency). **Read-back** = the write asks for the changed rows back, so a silent refusal (0 rows) is noticed. **Lock** = the button or form is disabled while saving (double click). **Confirm** = second press / password / confirm dialog. **Role** = page-side role pre-check (the database enforces roles in every case). Hand-checked columns come from the classification file.
